name: Grade typed answers with partial credit and bounded marks
description: Submits a small set of typed answers to the live grading route and checks that each score is bounded by its question maximum.
steps: Enter two complete questions with different maximum marks and plausible student answers
Inspect both question-wise results and the total
expected: One result is shown for each question, partial credit is possible, and no score exceeds its question maximum.

name: Reject invalid manual marks and oversized question sets
description: Checks that invalid mark values and more than 15 manually entered questions are blocked before a grading request.
steps: Enter a question with a zero or greater-than-100 maximum and try to mark it
Correct the marks, add 16 manual questions, and try again
expected: A clear validation message appears in each case and no score is generated.

name: Handle a managed AI service failure without partial scores
description: Injects a grading API failure and verifies Paperwise does not display stale or partial scores.

body_json.message: Simulated grading failure. No scores were accepted.

steps: Enter a complete typed question and answer
Run automatic marking while the API returns the injected failure
expected: A visible error appears, no result score is shown, and the user can retry.

name: Resolve section-level marks in an uploaded exam paper
description: Uploads a paper where a section heading is on the previous page, a question wraps across lines, and answers are out of order.
steps: Upload a clear two-page paper with the final section heading at the bottom of page 1 and a marked question beginning on page 2
Upload answers that reference those questions in a different order
Run automatic marking and inspect the resolved question maxima
expected: The page-break section context and wrapped question are recovered, explicit per-question marks are retained, and answer references are matched without falsely rejecting the paper.

name: Read scanned pages on mobile and fail safely when text is unreadable
description: Checks the mobile upload workflow for scanned pages in supported languages and verifies unreadable pages do not produce invented marks.
steps: Upload a clear scanned question-paper page and answer-sheet page
Wait for text extraction and run marking
Repeat with an unreadable or blank scan
expected: Readable text can proceed to marking; an unreadable page produces a clear error and no score.
